description.value: Deer Lodge is a self-catering vacation rental by owner tucked in the heart of Whistler Town Plaza, offering a one-bedroom suite sleeping four and a studio suite sleeping two. Both units feature full kitchens, gas fireplaces, in-suite laundry, and access to a shared hot tub, making them well suited for self-sufficient travellers. Restaurants, shops, golf courses, and ski lifts are all within easy walking distance.
